label: Corporate Wealth
description: India's biggest companies and the people who run them

items.label: Combined Wealth of India's Billionaires
items.context: Forbes 2024 counted ~200 Indian billionaires with combined net worth exceeding ₹80 lakh crore — more than twice India's annual health + education budgets combined.

items.label: Reliance Industries Market Cap
items.context: India's most valuable company by market capitalisation, spanning refining, telecom (Jio), retail and new energy.

items.label: TCS Market Capitalisation
items.context: Tata Consultancy Services, India's largest IT exporter, is among the world's top 10 most valuable IT companies.

items.label: Mukesh Ambani Net Worth
items.context: Asia's richest person. His wealth is roughly equal to 6× India's annual education budget.

items.label: HDFC Bank Market Cap
items.context: India's largest private-sector bank by assets and market value.

items.label: Infosys Market Capitalisation
items.context: India's second-largest IT exporter, co-founded by N.R. Narayana Murthy.

items.label: Gautam Adani Net Worth
items.context: Founder of the Adani Group, spanning ports, airports, power, green energy and media.

items.label: Zomato IPO Valuation
items.context: India's largest internet IPO at the time, food-delivery startup Zomato listed at a valuation of ₹64,000 crore in July 2021.
